name: Liquid Smoke Cursor
description: A WebGL fluid smoke cursor for React: a real GPU fluid simulation (velocity, pressure, vorticity) follows the pointer and fades out behind it. Full-page overlay or inside one box, any colour or rainbow, four blend modes, dot or ring cursor, click bursts. Sleeps when still, no dependencies.

props.name: rainbow
props.description: Cycle the hue on its own.

props.name: blend
props.description: Blend mode with the page. Screen for dark sites, multiply for dark ink on light ones.

props.name: force
props.description: How hard the pointer pushes the fluid.

props.name: swirl
props.description: Vorticity: how much the smoke curls.

props.name: shading
props.description: Soft light on the smoke's folds.

props.name: clickBurst
props.description: A click or tap puffs smoke out in a ring.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Draws a dot or ring at the pointer. To hide the arrow, add cursor-none to your page.

props.name: cursorSize
props.description: Dot size in px (a ring is 2.8× this).

props.name: area
props.description: 'page' follows the pointer over the whole window: pin the component with fixed inset-0 (it never blocks clicks). 'inside' keeps the trail within this box.

props.name: hoverDetection
props.description: With a dot or ring and area 'page': grows over links and buttons, steps aside over text fields. Add data-smoke-hover to anything else that should count.

props.name: respectReducedMotion
props.description: Off for visitors who ask their system for less motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent.
